description: Provenance manifest for OCR'd primary source documents used in MCS-4 process parameter research. Each entry links a local text file to its original source, BibTeX citation key, and integrity checksum.

sources.original_title: Intel C4004 Single Chip 4-Bit P-Channel Microprocessor Data Sheet
sources.notes: Primary electrical specifications: supply voltage, clock timing, I/O levels, pin capacitance, output resistance, power dissipation.

sources.original_title: MCS-4 Micro Computer Set Data Sheet (November 1971)
sources.notes: Original November 1971 MCS-4 family data sheet covering 4001/4002/4003/4004. System-level timing and electrical specifications.

sources.original_title: Intel C4040 Single Chip 4-Bit P-Channel Microprocessor Data Sheet
sources.notes: 4040 variant specifications. Same process technology as 4004, extended instruction set and 7-level stack.
Comprehensive technical manual for the MCS-4 family. Contains detailed timing diagrams, instruction set, system design guidelines, and electrical characteristics.
Technical manual for the MCS-40 family (4040-based). Includes updated specifications and extended instruction documentation.
Advance specifications for MCS-40 family components.

sources.original_title: MCS-4 Catalog Entry (Intel 1975 Product Catalog, page 302)
sources.notes: Brief catalog entry for MCS-4 family.

sources.original_title: MCS-40 Catalog Section (Intel 1975 Product Catalog, pages 232-252)
sources.notes: Extended catalog section for MCS-40 family. Contains detailed electrical specifications and timing.

sources.original_title: MCS-40 Catalog Section (Intel 1975 Product Catalog, pages 276-282)
sources.notes: Catalog section for MCS-40 peripheral components.
